question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Steal a march on**

options.text: Gain an advantage by acting before others do

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Gain an advantage by acting before others do**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The idiom **"Steal a march on"** means to gain an advantage over someone, especially by acting before them. (किसी पर बढ़त हासिल करना, विशेष रूप से उनसे पहले कार्य करके।)

 
 
• **Example:** By announcing the product early, the company managed to steal a march on its competitors.
 

 
• **Correct Meaning:** "Gain an advantage by acting before others do" (दूसरों से पहले कार्य करके लाभ प्राप्त करना।)
 
 
• **Example:** The candidate stole a march on her rivals by launching her election campaign well in advance.
 

 
• Hence, the correct meaning of the idiom is **Option 2**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Surrender unexpectedly** (अचानक आत्मसमर्पण करना): To give up or yield without warning.
 
 
• **Example:** The army was forced to surrender unexpectedly when they ran out of supplies.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: Betray one's allies** (अपने सहयोगियों के साथ विश्वासघात करना): To act disloyally or treacherously towards someone who trusts you.
 
 
• **Example:** Betraying one's allies during a crucial moment can lead to disastrous consequences.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: Escape punishment** (सजा से बचना): To avoid facing consequences for wrongdoing.
 
 
• **Example:** The criminal managed to escape punishment due to a lack of evidence.
